header.title: ROLES & SIGNALS IN BEACH
header.subtitle: No rotation, no fixed positions. Two functional roles (blocker · defender) that switch, and hand signals behind the back to coordinate block + defense.

facts.net: Net 2.43 m M · 2.24 m W · 2.35 m mixed
facts.service: Service zone: full width of the back

roles.title: The two functional roles
roles.intro: In 2v2, no fixed positions are imposed by the rules. But two complementary functions emerge — switching service after service, depending on who serves and which opponent you target.

items.label: BLOCKER
items.subtitle: At the net
items.profile: Tall, explosive jumper, reads the net
items.mission: Block, then peel back to defend. Hand signals before the serve.
tips: 30 cm from the net, hands at forehead height
Sealing: penetrate forward and downward into the opponent's court
Push the hands JUST AFTER the attacker's contact (later than indoor)
Spread, stiff fingers, thumbs parallel pointing up

items.label: DEFENDER
items.subtitle: In the back
items.mission: Cover the zone opposite the block, read the defense. Starts 1-1.5 m from the end line.
tips: Base position in the middle of the back
Slide toward the zone on the set
Stop your feet BEFORE the attacker's contact
Final read: shoulders + arm + wrist of the attacker

roles.switchingBody: Roles flip based on who serves / who receives / which opponent is targeted. If the blocker is too short: option to defend at 2 with no block (systematic peel/drop).

signals.title: Signals behind the back
signals.intro: The blocker informs their partner of their intent BEFORE their own team's serve. Signals are flashed behind the back (lower back), invisible to the opponent. One hand per opponent: right hand speaks for the opponent on the right, left hand for the one on the left.
signals.warning: The "closed fist" vs "open hand" conventions vary between teams. You must define the convention with your partner before every match.

items.defender: Starts neutral, breaks to the angle
Starts on angle, slides to the line
Runs down everything that gets by

signals.logicBody: The defender covers the zone the blocker does NOT take. Line block → angle defense. Angle block → line defense. Closed fist (pull) → defense at 2, court split in halves. Open hand (read) → real-time read.

calls.title: 2v2 communication
calls.intro: A study (Effectiveness of the Call in Beach Volleyball, 2011 Swiss Championships) shows that 61.5% of attacks WITH a call are winners vs 35% WITHOUT (p<0.0005). Short · loud · early · shared conventions · never silent.

groups.title: Calls during the rally
items: "Up!" — I'll dig it / dig it up
